title: The Fish Pedal Express
description: A great white pelican pedals a turquoise beach cruiser along a harbour quay: a curved golden scooping pouch, swept feather wings gripping the bars, webbed feet working opposing pedals, and a basket of freshly caught fish.

sections.name: Compact harbour quay and local water
Curved tyres and open spoked wheels
Opposing pedals and sculpted webbed feet

Swept feather wings holding the bars
Continuous scooping pouch and long yellow bill
Fish delivery basket and quay crate
